translations.web: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.
translations.bsb: When the people heard this bad news, they went into mourning, and no one put on any of his jewelry.
translations.kjv: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
